summary: Far Watch and the Crossroads 12-15, Ratchet loop 15-17, northern Barrens 16-18, Stagnant Oasis and Lushwater 17-20, Camp Taurajo 19-20, then hand-off to the 20-30 route.

tips.general: Undead coming by zeppelin skip this: Conscript of the Horde starts in Razor Hill.

steps.objectiveText: Follow the western road from Razor Hill to the Barrens over a bridge.
Follow the western road from Kargal's Far Watch Outpost.
Speak with Ak'Zeloth in the Barrens.

tips.general: Get the Crossroads flight path first thing.

tips.speed: Speedrun: take every Crossroads quest in one visit, then do them in loops (north-east camp, west pools, east to Ratchet) and only come back with several finished.
tips.general: Set your hearth at the Crossroads; most of the next 7 levels loop back here.

profTips.text: Waylaid Crates drop from mobs and chests while you quest. Fill one with any one of the bundles on its tooltip and bring it to Dokimi; your first crate also gives a Shipping Label quest worth 50 Merchant's Favor.

tips.general: Forever: Dokimi (Durotar Supply and Logistics) stands in the trade camp just outside the Crossroads west gate. Hand in filled Waylaid Crates here for Merchant's Favor, which buys recipes no trainer teaches.

steps.objectiveText: Follow the western road from Kargal's Far Watch Outpost.

tips.general: Tauren: hand in Journey to the Crossroads to Thork.

steps.objectiveText: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.

professionHooks.text: Keep Strider Meat from the plainstriders you kill for Plainstrider Menace. Tari'qa (Trade Supplies, the Crossroads) sells Recipe: Strider Stew.

steps.objectiveText: Collect 7 Plainstrider Beaks and return them to Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
Of the Razormane tribe, kill 8 Water Seekers, 8 Thornweavers and 3 Hunters, and then return to Thork in the Crossroads.
Bring 12 Raptor Heads to Gazrog at the Crossroads.
Report back to Tonga Runetotem with your findings.
Bring 4 Fungal Spores to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads.
Bring the Secure Crate to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
Collect 8 Witchwing talons.

tips.general: Plainstriders are everywhere around the Crossroads. Kill them between other objectives instead of hunting them separately.

tips.general: The Razormane camp is north-east of the Crossroads. Water Seekers and Thornweavers stand together, so pull pairs and tag both at once.

tips.general: The Forgotten Pools are north-west of the Crossroads; walk into the pool to explore it. Kill Zhevra Runners on the way for The Zhevra.

tips.general: Back to the Razormane camp north-east of the Crossroads: geomancers, defenders and Kreenig Snarlsnout are deeper in the same camp.
tips.tank: Pull Kreenig away from the defenders.
tips.healer: Kill the geomancers first; they cast from range.
tips.dps: Burst Kreenig once his guards are down.

tips.speed: Speedrun: after this first run, fly between Ratchet and the Crossroads instead of running.

tips.general: Forever quest. The Handfuls of Complicated Parts are south of Ratchet; it rewards a Scuffed Shipping Crate.

steps.objectiveText: Collect 5 Handfuls of Complicated Parts from the upper pirate camp south of Ratchet, then return to Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet.

Bring the head of Baron Longshore to Gazlowe in Ratchet.

tips.general: The Southsea pirates camp on the shore south of Ratchet. Baron Longshore, Stolen Booty and Southsea Freebooters are all in the same camp, so clear it once.
tips.tank: Pull pirates one at a time; they come in groups of two or three near the tents.
tips.healer: Fight on the edge of the camp so you can drink between pulls.
tips.dps: You need 6 cannoneers and 12 brigands; tag the cannoneers when you see them, they are the scarcer of the two.

tips.general: Escort: stay close to the shredder and kill the attackers that come at it. If you are low on health, wait until you are full before you start it.

tips.general: Forever elite quest at the Dustwallow border. Bring a friend or do it at 21-22.
tips.tank: Pull the soldiers one at a time and fight with a wall behind you.
tips.healer: Do this with a group; the soldiers come in pairs.
tips.dps: Kill the casters first, and use crowd control on the second soldier.

tips.general: Forever elite (level 21) in the Thorn Hill lair. It is given by Gur'ak and pays 6,150 XP plus a weapon or shield. Bring a group of 2 or 3.
tips.tank: Hold the boss with its back to you so the others stay out of its swing.
tips.healer: Keep the tank up; there are adds near the lair.
tips.dps: Kill the adds first, then the boss.

tips.dps: Stay behind him and save cooldowns for the start of the fight.
